name: @mocanvas/wasm
description: Typed loader and zero-copy bridge over the mocanvas Rust/WebAssembly engine.
author: Symbio Digital

scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && node scripts/prepare-pkg.mjs && tsup
scripts.build:dev: wasm-pack build ../../crates/mocanvas-wasm --dev --target web --out-dir ../../packages/wasm/pkg --out-name mocanvas && node scripts/prepare-pkg.mjs
scripts.prepack: node ../../scripts/bundle-docs.mjs ARCHITECTURE.md BENCHMARK.md CLEAN_ROOM.md COMPAT.md CUSTOM_SHAPES.md MIGRATION.md UI.md && pnpm run build
